storyTitle: Reviewing Holiday Goal & Statement Credit Options
oneSentenceStory: Daniel views his 7,300 coin balance and evaluates current statement credit progress toward his Holiday Spending Money goal.
customerSituation: Customer visits the rewards overview on mobile with the intent to check balances and evaluate statement credit options.
storyTension: Determining how current point totals translate into bill reduction and progress toward the 1,200 target.
customerResolution: Clear visibility of cash-equivalent point value, 53% goal progress, and straightforward statement credit redemption pathways.
primaryOutcome: Immediate clarity on cash-equivalent value and progress toward payment-linked savings goals.
